description: A gift exchange as one of the people in it sees it.

hatId.description: The unique identifier for the hat.

name.description: The display name of the hat.

status.description: The current status of the gift exchange. Everybody's pick is shown once it is CLOSED.

additionalInformation.description: Anything else the organizer wanted the participants to know.

exchangeDate.description: The approximate day of the exchange, as yyyy-MM-dd, or 0001-01-01 when the organizer has not given one

participants.description: Everybody in the exchange, the caller included.

name.description: The name to show. Followed by the address in brackets only when another participant shares the name.

emoji.description: The face this participant is marked with.

pickedRecipient.description: Who they are giving to. Empty for anybody but the caller until the exchange is closed.
